name: nuottitreeni
description: Free, privacy-first piano note trainer for the browser: learn to read sheet music with any MIDI keyboard. Works offline.
author: Markus Silvo (https://markussilvo.fi)

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8797
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run && npm run test:browser

DB.description: D1 database for the optional **sync codes**. Created for you; the first migration also creates a random rate-limit salt, so no secret is needed.

OPERATOR_NAME.description: Who runs this copy, shown on the privacy and about pages (your name or organisation). Leave empty to show a generic notice.

OPERATOR_CONTACT.description: Contact for privacy and accessibility questions: an email address or a URL. Shown on the privacy page.

SYNC_ENABLED.description: `true` lets visitors create sync codes stored in your D1 database. Set to `false` to offer only local storage and file export/import.
